race.comment: BIT UNSURE (4) is a promising dog yet to miss the frame after six starts including three wins and was a last start winner (19.05) over 350m at Q Straight. On top here on best form and expected to feature. FEDERAL ACE (3) showed good early burn and was there until turning but swamped late to finish 6th at Q Straight in a Grade 5. Likely to be about the money. SPARTAN (2) goes very well this trip starting five times for two wins and two minors. Below best last time at this track (19.84) in a Restricted WIN, finishing a 4.5 lengths fourth. Looks suited here and can measure up. CYCLONE LEO (1) is worth including after a top-three finish at this track and distance most recently.
